settings.title: Six courses, one promise: you will make something

settings.editor: Every course ends with a project of your own. Classes run in the evening or on Saturdays, in groups of fourteen or fewer.
HTML, CSS and JavaScript from an empty file to a site you put online yourself.

settings.title: Data analysis with spreadsheets and SQL

settings.editor: Ask a question of a dataset and answer it with a chart your manager can read.
Layout, type and colour for screens, practised on a real brief from a local company.
Meetings, email and small talk. Groups of eight, taught entirely in Spanish from week three.
Get off automatic. Light, composition and editing, with a walk out of town each week.
Reports, proposals and difficult emails, edited line by line in a small group.
Web development, data analysis and interface design are the three that most often lead to a change of role. Each has a careers evening.

settings.title: I want to be better at the one I have

settings.editor: Writing clearly and Spanish for work fit around a full week and show results in the first month.
Photography weekends are for the pleasure of it. No homework, four Saturdays, a lot of walking.

settings.title: Not sure which course fits? Come to an open day.

settings.editor: Sit in on a class, meet the instructors and ask every question you have. No booking, no sales talk.
